verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct citation). The publisher/book description confirms The Assault on Truth concerns Freud's seduction theory, child sexual abuse, and later adult mental illness. It does not support the added claim that the book lays out trauma-based mind control. The child-abuse component is supported; the mind-control component is not.

sources.relevance: Book metadata and synopsis confirm its actual child-abuse/Freud subject matter but not trauma-based mind control.

records.text: The author of The Assault on Truth controlled the Sigmund Freud Archives and lost his career for warning about what the scientists knew.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This person wasn't just an author that was guessing when he wrote this book. He was in control of the Sigmund Freud archives and lost his entire career just trying to ring the alarm on what these scientists knew.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct claim). The Supreme Court's Masson v. New Yorker opinion confirms Jeffrey Masson was hired as projects director of the Sigmund Freud Archives and was terminated after publicly advancing his theories. He did not 'control' the archives, and the claim that he lost his entire career is overstated; he continued as an author and independent thinker.

sources.title: Masson v. New Yorker Magazine, Inc., 501 U.S. 496 (1991)
sources.relevance: Official court opinion confirms Masson's projects-director role and termination.
